title: Vania Volpe - Lo Scivolo
comment: Single source of truth for the Vania playthrough, shared by the native C test (via tools/gen_playtest.py -> a generated header) and the browser test (test/web/run_playtest.js reads this file directly). Coordinates are fractions of the 800x600 logical screen. Vania has real recorded voice and cannot be interrupted mid-line, so each wait_ms is sized as the walk to the hotspot plus the recorded line (up to 8.3s) plus margin; a short wait silently drops the next click. Expected lines are accent-free substrings of the it_IT transcripts, which unlike Gina's are written with real accents.

steps.note: hub -> Vania (first button)
intro Gioca! -> the playground entrance
the slide over the fence -> he wants in
the gate -> locked, he needs a key
the gate again -> the second hint points at the sandbox
the shovel -> he digs and uncovers the key
pick the key up
the gate opens -> the playground
the slide -> a step is missing
the slide again -> ask the squirrel
the squirrel -> he wants acorns
the squirrel again -> try the other tree
shake the acorn tree -> they fall
pick the acorns up
trade the acorns -> the squirrel drops the peg
pick the peg up
the peg fixes the missing step
slide down (1 of 3): the arc, then he walks back to the ladder
and again (2 of 3)
and again (3 of 3) -> the next tap anywhere ends it

a tap anywhere ends the adventure. It lands back at the hub rather than on the end card: this tap's DOWN switches to the outro and its UP is then delivered there, which navigates away (tracked in #182)
